name: wastemap
description: Interactive 3D map of Hong Kong waste management facilities, built on official EPD / CSDI open data.

paragraphs: An interactive 3D map of Hong Kong's waste management facilities, built on official EPD (Environmental Protection Department) data published through CSDI / data.gov.hk.
Facilities are drawn as extruded pillars: colour encodes the facility type and height encodes published throughput. Bilingual (English / 中文).
features: 3D pillars via MapLibre GL + deck.gl, with a pitch/bearing view of Hong Kong.
Two map styles, no API keys required: Esri World Imagery (default) and
the Lands Department official map, whose labels switch language with the UI. Setting NEXTPUBLICMAPBOXTOKEN optionally upgrades the satellite slot to Mapbox satellite-streets-v12.
Category filter chips (All / Landfills / RTS / Parks) and a legend with
per-category counts. Both drive the same state, so they can never disagree.
